method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts: the Social Assistance Act with its Income Assistance Regulations (R-038-2024) and Income Assistance for Seniors and Persons with Disabilities Regulations (R-037-2024). Seat-neutral core (nt-sa.l4; the benefit tables generated by script from the deposited text), dated duties as regulative rules (nt-sa-duties.l4), and a seat layer for the applicant and recipient, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a family of more than three adults, or none, answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Social Assistance Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.S-10, consolidated to 2018-11-21 (../../registers/source-bundle/social-assistance.a.2018-11-21.txt); Income Assistance Regulations R-038-2024 consolidated to 2026-07-06 (../../../income-assistance-regulations/registers/source-bundle/social-assistance.r1.2026-07-06.txt); Income Assistance for Seniors and Persons with Disabilities Regulations R-037-2024 consolidated to 2026-07-06 (../../../income-assistance-for-seniors-and-persons-with-disabilities-regulations/registers/source-bundle/social-assistance.r5.2026-07-06.txt). English version; the French is equally authoritative.

scope: Act ss 8(1), 13, 15; IA Regulations ss 2, 3, 3.1, 4, 5, 10(3), 14, 19(1), 20(1)(c), (2), 22 (monthly income, allowable income, the bank-money exemption), Schedule items 1-5 and both tables; SPD Regulations ss 2, 3, 4, 4.1, 5, 6, 11(3)-(5), 14, 19(1), 22 (net annual income), Schedule items 1-4 and both tables. Out: Director-determined amounts (bridge, child care, emergency, education, minimal assistance), tuition and book allowances, homeowner and mortgage allowances, security deposits, record suspension fees, welfare services, retroactive assistance, absence from the Territories, recovery, appeal procedure, families of more than three adults.
seat: the applicant for or recipient of income assistance (including the senior, the person with a disability and their spouse)
